what: The whole panel stays faded at sepia .5 and gray 70% and still, then after 4s its true color returns over 2s with cubic.out. A start where an old photo slowly comes alive. With on: event it counts from when the fx:bloom event is sent to the document (for example when the first popup closes).

options.on: If event, starts when an fx:bloom event reaches document (default: counts the delay as soon as it is attached)

use: …

from.where: index.js addAc·startAc — .sec-slides-container is held at sepia(.5) grayscale(70%), and when a BGM popup is chosen it goes to sepia(0) grayscale(0%) after 4s in 2s cubic.out
from.options: sepia: .5; gray: 70; delay: 4; dur: 2; on: event
